# Commit

Stage changed files, run tests, then commit with a well-formed message.

Format: `<emoji> <imperative description>` — ≤72 characters, no period.

| Emoji | When |
|-------|------|
| ✨ | New feature |
| 🐛 | Bug fix |
| ♻️ | Refactor |
| 🧪 | Tests only |
| 📖 | Docs |
| 🔧 | Config / tooling |
